commentary_title: Market activity strengthens as laden tonnage boosts in the West
commentary_summary: The Aframax tonne-miles index inched up to 95 in week 46, marking a slight rise. | Robust market activity and notably higher utilisation compared with the previous week continued to support firm freight rates in the Aframax segment. | Both ballast and laden speeds declined, while the share of laden tonnage fell slightly in the East but increased in the West, helped by solid activity levels in the North Sea market.
